title: Unified Command performs controlled demolition, precision cutting
description:
Salvors with the Unified Command perform a controlled demolition, precision cutting of section 4 of the Francis Scott Key Bridge that sits on the port side of the bow of the M/V DALI, May 13, 2024, Key Bridge Response 2024.

Debris and wreckage removal is ongoing in support of a top priority to safely and efficiently open the Fort McHenry Channel.

(U.S. Army Corps of Engineers photo by Christopher Rosario)
